title: Koska Reeves
description: As a member of Bo-Katan Kryze's Clan Kryze, Koska Reeves was an efficient martial warrior who followed her leader on her quest to retrieve the Darksaber from Moff Gideon. When Bo-Katan called for allies to retake Mandalore from Moff Gideon, Koska Reeves joined her and fought against the Imperial remnants to save her home from occupation.
